sentences.text: The gold loan FAQ does not state any pre-payment percentage.
The FAQ only says a gold loan is against pledged gold ornaments, the loan amount is a percentage of assessed value within the applicable loan-to-value ceiling, and the tenure is up to 12 months.

The code-verified pre-payment rules are not applicable on the facts provided because their applicability is still unknown and they require borrower, purpose, rate type, facility, amount, and sanction-date details that are not in the case facts.
